notes.notes:
Happy Birthday MaCaw!
Captain MaCaw is 5 this week!

Updated the store art and patched the main game.

[list]
[*]Re done the front end and instructions screen to look better and align with the new store art.
[*]Various spelling errors in chat text resolved.
[*]Fixed some anti-aliased text that should not have been anti-aliased.
[*]Made jumping up the trees in the woods a little more forgiving.
[*]Made the "Butterfly tree" easier to land on and harder to fall off.
[*]Varied the animation speed of the butterflies.
[*]Made yellow objects easier to see if dropped against the yellow tree.
[*]Made an optional item easier to find.

notes.title: Version 1.11 released
notes.notes:
1.11 released fixing the following bugs.

[list]
[*]Game breaking bug where if you saved at 1 certain point in the game and quit, it did not save the player status and prevented progress.
[*]Hidden achievement that should trigger after the end sequence played moved to the start of the end sequence to fix a rare bug where it would not trigger.
[*]Also makes sure the player gets the achievement if they quit during the end sequence.
[*]Moved the game completion achievement to the start of the end sequence for the same reason. 
[/list]

•	Added some more hint panels.
•	Changed some in game text to fix grammatical errors.
•	Made MaCaw’s dialect “More Piratey”.
•	Added new item.
•	Added new puzzle for item.
•	Added new npc for puzzle.
•	Slight redesign on one of the beach rooms.

•	Made the hot spring easier to get back out from as it was a little tough so early in the game.

•	Added new achievements.

notes.notes:
Small update to solve a bug where if you complete a series of events in a certain order, it can cause a bug where you can not trigger the end sequence.

Means a lot to a tiny independent publisher where every review counts, truly!

notes.title: Captain MaCaw - Released!
notes.notes:
Captain MaCaw has now been released and is available on the steam store!

It is a platform adventure in the style of the old 8-bit puzzle adventures, featuring pirates in this instance!

Captain MaCaw's ship goes down in a storm!
Making sure everyone has cleared the ship, as is the captain’s duty, even a pirate captain, MaCaw gets to the last lift raft.
Washed aboard a strange island, he must work out how to get back home!
He soon discovers that is not as easy as he had hoped and begins to get a strange feeling that something is not quite right......

Thanks to everyone that have supported us on our first release!
The countless nights testing and feedback!

It's been a crazy journey one of which I'm proud of the result.

It's very much a passion project with the purpose of scratching that retro itch.
Giving you that nostalgic pang of firing up the ZX spectrum on a cold winters day!

While every step has been taken to squish bugs, you're never going to catch them all so if any do become apparent, please report through the contact links and they will be addressed promptly.

I am very much an active dev and want your experience playing Captain MaCaw to be as fun as possible!

I truly hope you enjoy!
